intent: Record the publishing rules a requirements patrol changed or added.
observable_outcome: get-context publishing lists the rules as reviewed, each proven by its test.

acceptance_criteria.statement: When a published Skill is deleted its publication retires; for 90 days after that its old address still answers withdrawn and the publisher cannot give its name to another Skill; after 90 days the name passes to another of the same publisher's Skills and the address follows it.
